name: hcapp_joinEventAsVisitor
description: Adds a virgin (type=1) or visitor (type=2) to an event. Uses a 'placeholder user' pattern: a synthetic Hasher record is created for the kennel (using KennelId as the Hasher.id PK) if none exists, and the visitor's HasherEventMap.UserId is set to the KennelId. Idempotent: if a HEM record with the same DisplayName already exists for this event, returns the existing record without creating a duplicate.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to add the visitor to.

parameters.name: displayName
parameters.description: Visitor's name. Used for deduplication check.

parameters.name: virginVisitorType
parameters.description: 1 = Virgin, 2 = Visitor. SP only operates for these values — silently does nothing for other values.

rowsets.name: StandardErrors
rowsets.description: Standard error format. errorType=2 for null userId/eventId. errorType=3 for auth failure.

rowsets.name: AdHocResult
rowsets.description: Returned when @virginVisitorType is 1 or 2. Single row.

columns.name: hasherEventMapId
columns.description: The new or existing HEM record's ID.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.Hasher — placeholder user (id = KennelId) if not already present
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — if no existing record with matching DisplayName
EXEC hcapp_syncEventAdminData — returns multiple result sets

codeSmells.issue: Placeholder Hasher uses KennelId as primary key
codeSmells.detail: The synthetic Hasher record's id is set to the kennel's UUID (h.id = k.id). This is a deliberate but unusual design — the Kennel record IS the placeholder Hasher. Any query joining Hasher to Kennel by id will find this record. This pattern must be documented and preserved in HC6.

The entire SP body is wrapped in an IF (@VirginVisitorType = 1 OR @VirginVisitorType = 2). For any other value, the SP returns no rowset and makes no changes — the caller gets an empty response with no error.

codeSmells.issue: HasherEventMap.UserId set to KennelId — not the visitor's ID
codeSmells.detail: Visitors have no Hasher record, so UserId is set to the KennelId as a flag. Any code that joins HEM.UserId to Hasher will find the placeholder Hasher, not a real person. Callers must check VirginVisitorType != 0 before treating UserId as a real user.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the KennelId-as-UserId placeholder pattern without a migration plan
